breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses both σ_avg and τ_avg in the maximum in-plane shear stress formula: τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)² + τ_avg²). It does not ignore the normal stress contribution, computing τ_max = sqrt((3.125)² + (2.50)²) = 4.00 MPa, which matches the ground truth approach of including both stress components in the formula.
